Since 0.1.15. The major version stays 0.

### Thor
Settings › Plugins lists Foldcade Thor, and installs it from its trusted release the same way as Foldcade Moonlight. Its page has a Control this device switch. With no plugin, with that switch off, or without a capability, Foldcade is unchanged. Foldcade never holds root. While Magisk has not allowed the plugin, Root access follows the switch. It says Magisk won't ask, and to add Foldcade Thor under Magisk › Superuser. A opens Magisk when it can, and otherwise says Check again. Coming back to Home updates the row. The card says Needs root until then. With no root at all, the row says it needs a rooted Thor (#416).

Settings › Thor, between System and Plugins, lists Fan and Stick lights for what the plugin can do. Fan steps Quiet, Balanced, and Performance, and shows Stock while that is the fan's own curve. Stick lights steps Off, Charging, Breathe, and Plugged in. Left, Right, and A step them. If Charging or Breathe is refused for want of a stick color, those two leave the list, the row says to set one in AYN › RGB lighting, and A opens AYN's settings. They come back once a color may have been set, including when you return to Home (#416).

R1's Fan, under the brightness, shows the tier in force, including a game's while that game holds it (#416).

Y › Fan sits under Open with on every game Foldcade launches: a ROM, a Moonlight stream, an Android game, and a GameNative or DroidDeck game. It is not on an app, an emulator, a folder, or an empty slot. It steps Default, Quiet, Balanced, and Performance. Default sends nothing when the game starts. The choice is saved with that game, and a setup backup carries it, as it carries Open with. While a game with its own tier is on a screen, the highest of those tiers holds. When the game ends, your tier returns. Choosing a tier in Settings or in R1 ends that hold, and the games then on screen keep the tier you set until another game starts (#416).

In Settings › System › Layout, when the plugin can power the screens, Top only powers the bottom screen off as well as darkening it. Bottom only puts the grid, the islands, their menus, and every full page on the bottom screen, and powers the top off. It is offered only then, and once chosen it stays until you step away from it. A screen a game is about to take is lit first, and a dark screen is darkened again after the device wakes. Turning Control this device off lights both screens. In those one-screen layouts, A opens a one-screen game on the lit screen and X opens it on the dark one, and Play on leaves Settings › System (#416).

### Brightness
With a plugin that sets the bottom screen's own level, R1 opens on one Brightness slider for both screens. The top goes through Android's brightness setting and the bottom through the plugin, at the same position. A splits it into Top and Bottom, each named beside the sun, with the focus on Top. A on either links both screens at that slider's level, and the focus returns to the one slider. The hints say Split and Link. The split lasts that R1 visit, even while the levels meet, so a held D-pad keeps its slider. The next time R1 opens, matching screens are one slider again. R1 also opens split whenever the screens differ by more than a point, and it reads the plugin as it opens, so a level set outside Foldcade shows up. A held A splits or links once. Until Foldcade may change system settings, A on the one slider, on Top, or on Bottom when linking, still asks you to allow it. Bottom alone can still move. Without that plugin, R1's brightness is the one slider it was (#418).

### Tests
The device-control tests now wait for a settle that started after the call. A pass that had already begun can no longer end that wait early. What the fan, the lights, and the screens do is unchanged (#417).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
- On Android 17, Android's folder picker can't choose a folder under `Android/data`. Save sync for an emulator that keeps its saves there needs that emulator's data or save folder moved to shared storage first.
